description: JSON Schema for bridge query/mutation templates. Validates the structure used by the bridge package (SparqlQueryBuilder, ResultSetJsonMapper, RdfJsonBridge) to execute SPARQL queries against an RDF dataset and produce JSON output.

$type.description: Controls output shape. "array" returns a JSON array; "object" returns the first element. When absent, the bridge infers: 0 results -> null, 1 result -> single value, n results -> array.

$map.description: Maps SPARQL query results to JSON. Either a string (a single variable reference like "?name") or an object where each key maps to a value. Supported special keys: "@id" (SPARQL variable whose URI becomes the JSON @id), "@value"/"@type" (typed literal), "$fragment" (auto-expands a resource using configured fragment properties). Other keys become JSON properties resolved from SPARQL bindings. Supports modifiers via $ suffix: "?date$date:dd.MM.yyyy", "?name$upper". Also supports CURIE-based property access via "$foaf:name" (requires "@id" in the same $map). Nested JSON objects that contain "$where" are treated as sub-queries.

$where.description: SPARQL WHERE clause graph patterns. Each string is a triple pattern (e.g. "?person foaf:name ?name" or "?person a schema:Person"). Patterns are appended directly into the SPARQL WHERE block. IMPORTANT: patterns must NOT include a trailing '.' – the bridge's {@code SparqlQueryBuilder} adds the period automatically when building the final SPARQL query.

$filter.description: SPARQL FILTER expressions. Each string is a FILTER expression appended into the WHERE block, e.g. "LANG(?desc) = 'en'".

$limit.description: SPARQL LIMIT. Supports integer or variable reference ("?limit") resolved from query params or $default bindings.

$offset.description: SPARQL OFFSET. Supports integer or variable reference ("?offset").

$distinct.description: When true, adds DISTINCT to the SPARQL SELECT clause.

$from.description: SPARQL FROM clause. A string or array of graph URIs.

@context.description: JSON-LD @context object mapping prefixes to URI namespaces. Used to expand CURIEs in $where patterns and $map values.

$default.description: Default variable bindings. Values can be plain literals, URIs (via "@id"), typed literals (via "@value"/"@type"), or CURIE strings (e.g. "schema:Person"). These are resolved before query parameters are applied.

$pagination.description: Pagination configuration. Both offset and limit must be specified. Each can be an integer or a variable reference (e.g. "?offset") resolved from query params or $default bindings. When present, the bridge wraps the result as { "data": ..., "pagination": { "limit", "total", "totalPages", "currentPageIndex", "firstPage", "prevPage", "currentPage", "nextPage", "lastPage", "pages" } }.

mapValue.description: A value used in $map, $default, or $pagination. Represents a SPARQL variable reference ("?x"), a CURIE-based property access ("$foaf:name"), a JSON-LD literal/URI object, a nested query template object, or a plain JSON literal (string, number, boolean, null). Supports modifiers via $ suffix: "?date$date:dd.MM.yyyy", "?name$upper".

oneOf.description: JSON-LD literal/URI value. Used in $map and $default.
A nested query template. Detected by the presence of "$where". The bridge executes this as a sub-query with inherited bindings.

mapObject.description: $map value definition: maps SPARQL variables to JSON properties. See the top-level $map for details.
